name: Eq-bench
intro: EQ-Bench 是面向纯文本大语言模型的情绪理解基准。它要求模型阅读由 GPT-4 生成的冲突或紧张对话，为角色的四种候选情绪分别给出 0–10 强度，经过自我批评后再修订评分，并以与作者参考情绪分布的距离计算总分。
build_method: GPT-4对话生成, 作者制定问题与参考情绪强度, 精确零样本提示, 自动解析与距离计分
task_type: 情绪理解与人际动态推理
eval_feature: 四情绪强度评分, 批评与修订, 相对强度归一化, 解析失败门槛
build_method_en: GPT-4 dialogue generation, author-defined questions/references, exact zero-shot prompting, automatic parsing and distance scoring
eval_feature_en: Four-emotion intensity ratings, critique and revision, relative-intensity normalization, parseability threshold
intro_en: EQ-Bench is a text-only emotional-understanding benchmark for large language models. Models read GPT-4-generated conflict or tension dialogues, rate four candidate emotions from 0 to 10, critique and revise their ratings, and receive a score based on distance from author-defined reference emotion distributions.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Sample location, author style, and conflict/tension scenario seeds"] --> B["Use GPT-4 to generate emotionally nuanced dialogue scenes"]
    B --> C["Authors choose four diverse emotions and 0–10 reference ratings"]
    C --> D["Build 60 English emotional-understanding questions"]
    D --> E["Prompt zero-shot first-pass scores, critique, and revised scores"]
    E --> F["Parse at temperature 0.01; add 0.15 on failure for up to five retries"]
    F --> G["Normalize four ratings to sum 10 and score 10 minus absolute differences"]
    G --> H["Average first/revised runs separately, take the better run; fewer than 50 parseable answers fails"]

flowchart LR

    B --> C["作者选择四种差异化情绪并设定0–10参考强度"]
    C --> D["构建60道英文情绪理解问题"]
    D --> E["零样本输出首轮评分、逐步批评与修订评分"]
    E --> F["温度0.01解析；失败则每次加0.15，最多重试五次"]
    F --> G["将四情绪归一化为总和10，并以10减绝对差之和计分"]
    G --> H["分别平均首轮/修订轮并取更高整轮；可解析题少于50即失败"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the original December 2023 EQ-Bench paper arXiv:2312.06281 Sections 2.6 and 3.1–3.10, not the later Qwen3-VL report that merely cites the benchmark. The diagram records random location/author-style/scenario seeds; GPT-4 generation constrained to conflict or tension; author-selected questions, four diverse emotions, and reference ratings; 60 English items; exact zero-shot first-pass/critique/revised response structure; temperature 0.01 with +0.15 parse-failure increments until parseable or attempts exceed five; normalization of each four-emotion vector to sum 10; per-question score 10 minus the sum of absolute differences; random baseline 0 and perfect alignment 100; separate first-pass and revised-run averages with the better entire run selected rather than per-question cherry-picking; and failure below 50 parseable answers out of 60.
